The [[Amulet of the Mists]] is a [[Unique item|unique]] [[reward trophy]] that each [[character]] may obtain once from [[Suun]] in the [[Divine Path]] after completing [[Imperial Sanctum]]. Exchange it with one of the Adepts (listed below) located in the Divine Path for a unique item.

==Collectors==
*[[Adept of the Elements]] 
*[[Adept of Steel]] 
*[[Adept of Shadows]] 
*[[Adept of Nature]] 
*[[Adept of Illusion]] 
*[[Adept of Spirits]]
*[[Adept of Bone]] 
*[[Adept of Light]]
*[[Adept of Spears]] 
*[[Adept of Scythes]]

==Notes==
[[Image:Shimmering Scale Necklace.png|right|thumb|Shimmering Scale Necklace]]
*[[Shimmering Scale Necklace]]s have a similar inventory icon. Be wary of [[scam]]s.
